mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses equity discount rates by signaling monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), rising CPI signals imminent central bank tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falling below 1.5% signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that lowers consumer confidence and spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market downturns (HOUST < 1200.0 thousand units), declining housing starts signal reduced consumer spending on durable goods, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.
